name: Four Points by Sheraton Singapore, Riverview
short_description: Singapore's first Four Points by Sheraton, on the Singapore River in Robertson Quay, near Havelock MRT and the CBD.
ai_summary: Four Points by Sheraton Singapore, Riverview sits on Havelock Road along the Singapore River in Robertson Quay, a five-minute walk from Havelock MRT and a short ride from the CBD, Clarke Quay, and Orchard Road. As Singapore's first Four Points property, the hotel is built for straightforward business and leisure stays, with an on-site mall, three restaurants, a rooftop garden, and an outdoor pool alongside a 24-hour fitness centre. Guest reviews describe the riverside location as a genuine advantage for reaching restaurants and attractions on foot, and rooms are repeatedly called modern, clean, and comfortable, with river or city views from most floors. Service draws praise for being attentive and professional, though with occasional inconsistencies noted, and Elite members report solid breakfast and lounge-drink benefits even if upgrades are limited. As a select-service brand, it's positioned as a value-oriented base for travelers who want the Robertson Quay/CBD location without a luxury-hotel price tag. The recurring watchouts are the kind typical of a busy select-service property: some guests mention occasional maintenance or noise issues in rooms, housekeeping that isn't always responsive to specific requests, and unexpected extra charges on amenities that guests assumed were included.

faqs.question: Is Four Points by Sheraton Singapore, Riverview close to the CBD?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it sits on the Singapore River in Robertson Quay, a five-minute walk from Havelock MRT and a short ride from the Central Business District, Clarke Quay, and Orchard Road, making it a practical base for both business and leisure.

faqs.question: Does Four Points by Sheraton Singapore, Riverview have a pool?
faqs.answer: Yes -- the hotel has an outdoor pool along with a 24-hour fitness centre, an on-site mall, three restaurants, and a rooftop garden, positioning it as a value-oriented, select-service option in the Robertson Quay area.

reviews.title: Review: Four Points by Sheraton Singapore, Riverview
reviews.author: Jean-François Léveillé
reviews.summary: Rates it 9/10 and frames it as the most affordable central Marriott, bookable around 34,000 Bonvoy points. Praises the peaceful riverside setting, four restaurants, riverside pool and 24/7 gym, while noting compact 23sqm rooms.

reviews.title: Four Points by Sheraton Singapore Riverview: Honest Hotel Review
reviews.author: Rubbish Eat Rubbish Grow Editorial Team
reviews.summary: A candid 3.5/5 calling it the 'Honda Civic of hotels': dependable and functional. Highlights the Robertson Quay location near Havelock MRT and roomy-for-Singapore rooms with firm beds, offset by decor overdue for a refresh.

reviews.title: Hotel Review: Four Points by Sheraton Singapore, Riverview (Premium Room) — Cheap Property for Mattress Runs
reviews.author: Mark Chua
reviews.summary: Reviews the Premium Room from an elite-value angle, noting rates from ~S$146++ make it the cheapest Marriott in Singapore. Flags Platinum perks like evening drinks and 4pm checkout, and the a la carte Old Time Bak Kut Teh.

reviews.title: Staycation Review: Four Points by Sheraton Singapore, Riverview
reviews.summary: A staycation review of the 476-room hotel as one of Marriott's most budget-friendly Singapore stays. Notes angled windows giving broad river or city views from higher floors, plus dining at Four Points Eatery and food-credit deals.
